record.body:
## Evidence

POST /api/backlog and POST /api/needs returned 422 with detail loc query request. GET /openapi.json returned 500. Check-runs rec-deab58bb-0a02-40ca-868e-de425b27531e, rec-0b518d65-b4c2-4360-a1c3-bfcb93d4ccf6, and rec-67a58b69-b669-4333-8c04-abd2c30cba11 failed those assertions. After deleting from __future__ import annotations, the same tests passed at 29fec4bceaa72b8880b50dc8ceda560810cdfb09.

## Consequence

FastAPI never read the JSON body, so dismiss and Needs-you confirm could not run.

## Follow-up

none

payload.basis: Assertion failures on test_r1_backlog_dismiss and test_r2_needs_clear before the edit, and passes at 29fec4bc after deleting from __future__ import annotations.
payload.claim: Postponed annotations made FastAPI require a query parameter named request, so confirm writes returned 422.
payload.invalidated_when: POST /api/backlog or POST /api/needs returns 422 for a missing request query parameter again on the FastAPI app.
